notes: Known-answer navigation tasks for the rust lane. Needle-based, not line-based: bench/verify-tasks resolves every needle to a unique line at the current SHA, so the manifest survives edits without stale line numbers. Paths are relative to the lane root (rust/), not to the repository root. 'expect' blocks carry the ground truth a harness scores against; counts are minimums where marked. exact_count is exact and counts concrete, non-generic, unconditionally compiled types that satisfy the contract directly or through inheritance; abstract bases, blanket impls and cfg-gated impls are excluded. Kinds added by the fifth wave: build_generated (item spliced in by include! from OUT_DIR), path_attribute (#[path]-declared module), gat (generic associated type). Kinds added by the canonical-parity wave: barrel (import resolved through the crate-root pub use re-export), type_only (a use consumed only in type position, carrying no value-level edge), structural (a type that carries a trait's method set inherently without implementing it), deref_forward (a method reached through a Deref impl). For parents-class-one-plus-two, extends_count is the trait named on the impl line, implements_count its supertraits, and exact_count their total. document_symbol tasks count every named symbol the anchored FILE declares at any nesting depth (types, fields, functions, modules); each task's note enumerates that count N and states min_symbols = floor(0.75 * N), the 25% margin absorbing listings that fold container nodes. call_hierarchy tasks name callees under outgoing_includes and callers under incoming_includes; both are file+needle pairs the verifier resolves. Kinds added by the wave-2 parity pass: namespace_import (a module bound as a namespace, with one member read from it), same_name (two identically named functions in different modules, separated only by the path the call site writes), name_only (a topic matched by string literal, with no type or symbol edge between the subscribe site and the dispatch that reaches it).
